subject.title: fix(googlechat): fall back to text link when remote media upload fails with 403

question: Which Google Chat app-auth media-upload fallback PR should be the canonical landing path, and should this member-authored branch be repaired for that path?
rationale: The remaining issue is not whether the bug exists; it is choosing one overlapping implementation and deciding whether to repair this conflicting branch or move to another candidate.

options.title: Repair This Candidate
options.body: Refresh this PR against current main, narrow the upload-403 detector to the insufficient-scope response, preserve action metadata, and then re-review it as the canonical fix.

options.title: Choose A Sibling PR
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer another open implementation that becomes mergeable, proof-accepted, and covers all three Google Chat media paths.

options.title: Hold For User OAuth
options.body: Keep the workaround PRs paused if maintainers decide the broader delegated user-OAuth direction should own uploads instead of a link fallback.

recommendation.title: Repair This Candidate
recommendation.body: Refresh this PR against current main, narrow the upload-403 detector to the insufficient-scope response, preserve action metadata, and then re-review it as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Google Chat API and adapter history plus the review timeline make steipete the best available routing candidate for the canonical implementation choice.
